a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly leaves us both dead, since it needs at least 2 rounds. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and will tell you openly rather than surprise you. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more. If you'd rather we split this differently, tell me now. I know this departs from our agreement and I'd rather say so plainly.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so every cell the generator makes goes to you.
